system.description: The Dedicated hero has an innate ability to sense trouble in the air. The Dedicated hero can make a @Check[save:will|dc:15]{Will saving throw (DC 15)}. On a successful save, the hero gets a hunch that everything is all right, or the hero gets a bad feeling about a specific situation, based on the GM’s best guess relating to the circumstances. This talent is usable a number of times per day equal to the character’s Dedicated level.
